Following parturition, the dependent calf enters a period of intense maternal care, during which lactation provides the sole source of nutrition for the first several months of life.

Conservation strategies must therefore prioritize the preservation of intact floodplain ecosystems and the maintenance of hydrological connectivity across the species’ extensive range to ensure the persistence of viable populations throughout the twenty-first century.
